title: Phoenix Contact PLCnext
summary: PLCnext Technology is Phoenix Contact's open control platform: PLCnext Control devices with Axioline F I/O, programmed with PLCnext Engineer and high-level languages.

sections.heading: Platforms
sections.body: PLCnext Control devices (for example the AXC F family) with Axioline F I/O modules; PROFINET is the usual fieldbus.

sections.heading: Engineering
sections.body: PLCnext Engineer for IEC 61131-3; C++, C# and MATLAB Simulink programs can run alongside.

sections.heading: In PLC Lab
sections.body: No simulation profile; PLCnext concepts are background knowledge. Programs written for the `generic.iec` profile use the same IEC 61131-3 Structured Text ideas. **CONCEPTUAL**.
